svg.title: We put Bun's Rust rewrite in production on Prisma Compute
svg.desc: Peak resident memory in the Bun.S3File.arrayBuffer() loop inside a 1 GiB container: stable 1.3.14 runs past the 900 MiB threshold and is OOM-killed, while the Rust rewrite canary stays flat at 118 MiB to 4096 iterations. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand, prism red Compute accent.

g.text: The build that passed our tests
